text:
This notice is being sent to keep travelers informed about routine companion animal handling at Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers should review the basic care steps before departure so each animal can move through the journey with less stress and fewer delays. The Companion Animal Travel Desk gives clear guidance on carrier checks, document review, and handoff points, while the ground team moves carriers carefully between services. Trained staff give patient attention to every animal and watch for any change in comfort or condition.

If service details shift during processing, staff record the update in the desk ledger and pass the note along without delay. That record helps keep the handoff smooth and the travel plan consistent from start to finish. Travelers are also reminded to keep carriers secure, labels legible, and contact details current before arrival at the desk.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with any travel update or care concern.
